# Using the Node Tuning Operator {#nodes-node-tuning-operator}

{% include "./_attributes/common-attributes.md" %} {% include "./_attributes/attributes-openshift-dedicated.md" %} The Node Tuning Operator in OpenShift Container Platform helps you manage node-level tuning by orchestrating the TuneD daemon. You can use this unified interface to apply custom tuning specifications and achieve low latency performance for high-performance applications.
